newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index little changed in higher trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange on Tuesday closed little changed in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 597.27 from 597.67 on Monday.
Trade volume was 1.27 million dinars against 258,210 dinars.
BIAT bank was up 2.52 dinars to 62 dinars with 11,500 shares changing hands. STB bank gained 0.66 dinar to 22.82 dinars with 10,417 shares changing hands. ($=0.97 dinar)
